description: PVGIS typical meteorological year reference data for each park location in wide format

index.name: date
index.description: Date within typical year (year replaced with reference year for alignment)

columns.description: Each column represents a park_id, values are PVGIS reference metrics (power, irradiance, temperature)

source.transformation: load_pvgis_filtered_wide() - loads cached PVGIS data per park location

refresh_strategy.logic: Replace entire dataset when PVGIS data is updated or new parks added

partitioning.description: Single wide parquet file, contains typical year data (365/366 days)

deduplication.logic: Track hash of source PVGIS files to detect changes

data_quality.filters: Uses metadata park coordinates and status_effective filter
